title: Evaluating Arabic Large Language Models: A Survey of Benchmarks, Methods, and Gaps

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying benchmarks that evaluate cultural alignment using natively collected datasets (e.g., regional proverbs, Islamic jurisprudence, Arab commonsense reasoning) and identifying cultural misalignment or Western-centric biases introduced by translating mainstream English benchmarks into Arabic.

Analyzing NLP benchmarks that measure language model proficiency across Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and various regional dialects (e.g., Egyptian, Levantine, Gulf) to identify disparities in dialectal understanding and generation.

Evaluating the regional focus of current Arabic evaluation datasets to identify representational gaps, specifically noting an over-representation of standardized Saudi/Gulf variants and a lack of coverage for other Arabic-speaking regions like North Africa, the Levant, and Iraq.
